title: Floo Teleportation
description:
Right clicking a connected line of bricks with a Floo Sign will turn them into Floo Bricks and create a Floo Fireplace (up to about 20 bricks on the same level). When you are holding Floo Powder in your main hand while standing on top of Floo Bricks & type a message in chat you will be teleported to the fireplace which name is closest to the message you typed. Each teleport uses up one Floo Powder. The name of a fireplace is defined by the name of the Floo Sign used to create it (Rename it in an Anvil). Fireplaces without a name can still be used to teleport but can't be teleported to. Players will arrive facing the opposite direction you were facing while creating the fireplace. Breaking any Floo Brick turns the whole fireplace back into plain bricks.

You can also craft Floo Tokens which allow you to use the Floo Network on the go without a Fireplace, simply throw them on the ground and wait a few seconds. A "temporary fireplace" will appear that lasts about 13 seconds. It can be used like a normal brick fireplace, but it does not cost any Floo Powder.

Instead of having Floo Powder in your hand you can also have a floo pouch anywhere in your inventory. It holds 128 Floo Powder and is filled with floo powder from your inventory when you shift right click it.

Fireplaces only work within the same dimension: you cannot teleport to a fireplace in another dimension.

properties.label: Obtain
properties.value: Floo Powder, Floo Pouch, Floo Sign and Floo Token are crafted (see recipes)

properties.label: Cost
properties.value: 1 Floo Powder or 1 pouch charge per teleport

properties.label: Naming
properties.value: Rename the Floo Sign in an Anvil

recipes.note: Shapeless: the ingredients can be placed anywhere in the crafting grid.
